summary: Luke Pancoe debriefs Angelo DiMaggio on a call he just had with a content-agency owner who crossed seven figures in his first year with a team of 15 and sells a 30k offer. Luke did not pitch on the call and instead gave unsolicited feedback on the prospect's sales page, and now proposes rebuilding that sales page with AI as a goodwill gesture before asking for a follow-up 'deep dive' meeting. Angelo agrees with the lead-with-value approach. No Primal Instinct or Kettlebell Body content appears anywhere in the conversation.
notable: Neither speaker carries a '(Primal Instinct)' label and neither is Ben Byrne, whose Drive folder this file sits in.
Subject matter is a content/done-for-you agency selling a 30k offer moving to 50k, with a 10k downsell - unrelated to the Kettlebell Body programme.
Luke references an AI advising him on call strategy: 'AI told me I shouldn't even mention or pitched it'.
Proposed tactic is to use AI to rebuild a prospect's sales page and send it unprompted as a door-opener for a pitch meeting.
